summary: Subrogation rights post-resolution plan approval; Section 140 Contract Act applicability; admission of Section 7 IBC application against subsidiary despite partial payment by guarantor in parent company's CIRP; distinction between holding company and subsidiary assets under IBC; information memorandum exclusion of subsidiary assets; resolution plan terms extinguishing guarantees; liability continuation on principal borrower for balance dues.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; NCLAT judgment affirming admission of IBC Section 7 application against corporate debtor upheld; subrogation claim rejected; financial creditor entitled to pursue balance dues from principal borrower.
